full_judgment:
A.K.M. Asaduzzaman, J. This rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused petitioner should not be enlarged on bail in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 5019 of 2010 arising out of S.G.R. Case No.62/2010 corresponding to Sadar Daskhin P.S. Case No.01 dated 01.11.2010 under section 25-B of the Special Powers Act, 1974 read with under table 7(Ka) of section 19(1) of the Narcotics Act, 1990 rejecting the prayer for bail of the accused petitioner. 

 A Microbus having 790 bottles of phensedyl and one KG Gaza there from were recovered wherein the petitioner along with other were arrested stating that the petitioner is a helper of the microbus, accordingly a case under table 7(Ka) of section 19(1) of the Narcotic Control Act read section 25B of the Special Powers Act was started against the petitioner. 

 The learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 01.11.2010 and the case is lying before the court of Magistrate for trial and there is no certainty as to when the trial will be commenced. He further submits that the petitioner is a helper and victim of circumstances and the petitioner has got fair chance of acquittal in this case and the trial is delayed for no fault of the petitioner and as such the petitioner may be enlarged on bail. 

 On perusal of the fact narrated in the FIR and the present position of the case and considering that the petitioner has got fair chance of acquittal in this case and that the trial is delayed for no fault of the petitioner, we find substance in the submission of the learned advocate for the petitioner and are inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail. We find merits in this rule. 

 In the result, the rule is made absolute. The petitioner Md. Khorshed Alam Son of Md. Hafiz Miah may find bail on furnishing bail bond subject to the satisfaction of the learned Sessions Judge, Comilla in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 5019 of 2010 arising out of G.R. Case No.62/2010 corresponding to Sadar Daskhin P.S. Case No.01 dated 01.11.2010. The trial court however, is at liberty to cancel the bail, if the accused petitioner misuses in any way the privilege of bail.
